tvShow.name: Death Inc.
tvShow.overview: When the founder of Torregrosa Funeral Home dies, his scheming right-hand man is poised to take over the business. But the owner's widow has other plans.

guest_stars.character: Excompañera de piso de madre Dámaso
guest_stars.name: Nati Ortíz de Zárate

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Dámaso and Chemi vie for control of the funeral home. Nieves probes a urinary mystery. Two siblings split their father's funeral in half — in every way.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Chemi's "one day, one boom" scheme unleashes a slew of unusual initiatives on Torregrosa, and a chance encounter emboldens Vanesa to plot her revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Manuela tries to place a familiar face. Olivia follows her psychic's advice about her romantic future. Dámaso doesn't give up on Morales' mother.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: As Torregrosa prepares a farewell for a beloved pet, Abel's new girlfriend leads him into uncharted territory. Morales awaits news about his internship.
